physics_goals.quote: The LEGEND experiment ... searches for the 0νββ of 76Ge using High Purity Germanium detectors enriched in 76Ge beyond the 86%.
physics_goals.value: Search for neutrinoless double-beta decay of 76Ge with a staged, background-free germanium programme, progressing from 200 kg (LEGEND-200) to 1000 kg (LEGEND-1000) of enriched detectors

summary.plain: LEGEND combines the expertise of two earlier experiments, GERDA and the Majorana Demonstrator, to search for a rare radioactive process in germanium atoms deep under an Italian mountain. Its first stage, LEGEND-200, began taking data in 2023; a larger stage, LEGEND-1000, is planned.
summary.technical: Staged germanium 0νββ programme combining GERDA and MAJORANA DEMONSTRATOR technology. LEGEND-200 (up to 200 kg of enriched-76Ge detectors in liquid argon at LNGS) began data taking in 2023 and reported a first-result exposure of 61 kg·yr and T1/2 0ν > 0.5×10²⁶ yr (90% CL); a combined GERDA+MAJORANA+LEGEND-200 analysis gives T1/2 0ν > 1.9×10²⁶ yr (90% CL). LEGEND-1000 (1 t enriched Ge) is in preparation, targeting a discovery sensitivity beyond 10²⁸ yr.

unique_capabilities.quote: The LEGEND experiment (Large Enriched Germanium Experiment for Neutrinoless ββ Decay) searches for the 0νββ of 76Ge using High Purity Germanium detectors enriched in 76Ge beyond the 86%.
unique_capabilities.value: Staged germanium 0νββ programme reusing the GERDA liquid-argon-immersion technique with higher detector mass and enrichment at each stage
